title: List of spells that can be cast while silenced
html:
This is a list of all spells in Baldur's Gate 3 that can be cast while  Silenced. Most spells involve verbal components which prevents their use while silenced, but some do not. In addition to the spells listed below, any spell can be cast while silenced through  Metamagic: Subtle Spell.
